parsed.explanation: The quote appears essentially verbatim (the text reads "Theorem A (proved): for all $n$, $a_{n+1}$ = successor of $a_n$ in $S_\infty=\bigcap_m S_m$"), and the objection reads it as intended: a bare assertion of a result. Scanning the entire write-up, it is a status/tracking file: Theorem A and Lemmas A–D are only stated with the parenthetical tag "(proved)", plus the note "Proof via stabilization ... (finite $2^m$)" for Lemma D, which is a one-clause hint, not an argument. The "Full proof" section reads "(in progress — see approaches/ and lemmas/)", i.e. the proofs are outside the graded text. Hence the characterization (C) that the sequence equals $S_\infty\cap[a_1,\infty)$ is not established here, and the finiteness crux is explicitly admitted as unproven, so the periodicity conclusion is not obtained. Fatal for (C), (F), (P).
